expected_query_count_explanation: 2 receivers x 8 transmitters x 3 disjoint scenes x 30 original query records

source_calibration.selection: All five baselines fixed before target access; no target-based winner or tuning

seed_notes: Inherited source split checked in original contract; original fixed received keeps original overlay seeds. Evaluation seed only shuffles opaque records. No new augmentation, support fitting or random observation.

goals.confidence_interval: Report 95% intervals independently from point-estimate targets

technical_stop: Wrong contract/split/checkout, query/truth fitting, output collision, missing legal predictions or stage failure. Preserve all partial artifacts; only exact run-owned PIDs may be stopped. Poor scientific results do not trigger technical restart.
expansion_rule: No automatic 3-seed or full matrix expansion unless source-frozen candidate meets preregistered scientific constraints; any further source-only development remains separate from this historical target benchmark.
